note: The one matching SYX_A original becomes `date` with the entry's attribution; the same variable under SYX_B and in another register keeps its delivered type.
fails_if: `_compile_sos_register` matches a data-type entry's peers by variable name alone, without the `subject.variant.name == entry.deldatamangd` filter, so the SYX_B DATUM row joins the peers and the entry turns over-broad instead of making SYX_A DATUM `date`
